title: INJORA 51mm Aluminum Threaded Double Barrel Shock for AX24 SCX24, Gold

reviews.title: Great shocks for bigger tires
reviews.body: Injora always comes through with quality parts for good prices. These are some of the longest shocks available for the scx24, they work great with stuff springs for monster truck builds. You'll probably definitely find yourself needing some limit straps of some kind of you run these on a crawler. I'm running these (53mm) on my comp rig, and an identical set of  43mm on my more scale truck. Both lengths do great, no binding or catching.I do take each shock and work it back and forth, putting light pressure in alternating directions for about 30 seconds before I install them, it helps get rid of any burs left over from the machining process. I've never had one break or bend even on my heaviest builds. Hard to go wrong with Injora in my opinion
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 11, 2025

reviews.title: Good Value!
reviews.body: Awesome little upgrade for any scx24.  Seem true to size, but I'm not out there measuring. I did much research on Youtube before purchase.Remember, these are telecoping shocks. Not oil filled. But because of this, collapse and extend better than any other 24th scale shock I'd ever used. Work great on my SCX24 Deadbolt custom stretched frameOne thing I found is that they bind when stressed at angles. Since it's not a fluid motion like standard shocks, it's metal on metal. Not a big deal at all, but something I wasn't aware of. That would not have prevented me from buying them. Just something to note.Included with many parts necessary for a complete install.  A nice thing that would've made this even betterwould be to add 4-8 nylocks in the parts bag for those of us who do custom builds and don't necessarily screw into plastic.The major downside for me is the included extra springs are not color-coded whatsoever to decipher which ones are hard or soft. Or maybe my aging eyes couldn't tell the difference. The stiffness was too close to worry about, but apparently some Youtubers have noticed a difference.

reviews.title: Will need to relocate front mounts or buy the flex blade mounts!!! But work!
reviews.body: I got the SCX24 gladiator. Tried these out. Overall quality is 5 stars. However I did have to relocate the stock mounting point because there is TOO much flex! So rig up some limiting straps or purchase the flex blade mounts or the front drive shaft binds and falls apart, turning the drive shaft around helps... Aside from that they fit, work, and look amazing. (Hint I just used the longer screw and the very top screw hole holding the body latch)
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 25, 2025

Double Barrels Shock, telescopic design for maximum travel.
Long travel shocks for the AX24/SCX24 are ready for anything and everything you have to throw at them.
2 different spring rate options to cater to every rigs setup and weight. The compressed length hole-to hole is 27mm (1.06in).
Fit Axial AX24 SCX24 Upgrade RC Crawler Car.
